title: Venezuelan Paella
description: A classic Venezuelan paella recipe made with saffron-infused rice, beans, and chicken. This hearty dish is perfect for a special occasion or a weekend dinner.

ingredients.name: Beans (such as kidney or black beans)

instructions: Heat the butter in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the paella seasoning and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the beans and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Add the Venezuelan Paella Rice and stir to coat the rice in the butter and spice mixture.
Add the saffron threads and stir to combine.
Add the zesty chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
